name: AFLW: Annotated Facial Landmarks in the Wild
description: A pioneering large-scale real-world facial image database curated by Graz University of Technology (TU Graz). Contains 25,993 annotated face instances in 21,997 natural images gathered from Flickr, exhibiting extreme head pose variations, occlusions, age, gender, and illumination diversity. Each face is annotated with up to 21 facial landmarks using a SQLite database backend, accompanied by face bounding rectangles, face ellipses, and 3D head pose angles.
